land-report-a.zh: 指挥中心，目击客机坠落，请求支援。
land-report-a.en: Dispatch, airliner down. Request emergency assistance.

land-report-b.zh: 巡逻十二报告，发现坠落飞机，请派救援。
land-report-b.en: Patrol twelve, aircraft down. Send rescue units.

water-report-a.zh: 河面发现飞机落水，请求水上救援。
water-report-a.en: Aircraft down in the water. Request marine rescue.

water-report-b.zh: 水上巡逻报告，目击客机落水。
water-report-b.en: Marine patrol reporting an airliner entering the water.

runway-report-a.zh: 现场发现事故航空器，请派车辆检查。
runway-report-a.en: Aircraft incident reported. Send emergency vehicles to investigate.

runway-report-b.zh: 航空器需要应急支援，救援车辆出动。
runway-report-b.en: Aircraft requires emergency assistance. Dispatch rescue vehicles.

land-dispatch-a.speaker: dispatch
land-dispatch-a.zh: 指挥中心呼叫，消防三组、救护二组，前往事故区域支援。
land-dispatch-a.en: Fire three, medic two, respond to the crash site.

land-dispatch-b.speaker: dispatch
land-dispatch-b.zh: 巡逻十二封锁道路，消防三组前往现场支援，保持频道畅通。
land-dispatch-b.en: Patrol twelve, close the road. Fire three, respond.

water-dispatch-a.speaker: dispatch
water-dispatch-a.zh: 水警三号、救援二组，前往河面支援。注意水流。
water-dispatch-a.en: Marine three, rescue two, respond to the river.

water-dispatch-b.speaker: dispatch
water-dispatch-b.zh: 水警三号前往落水位置，救援二组沿岸接应，保持联络。
water-dispatch-b.en: Marine three, approach the aircraft. Rescue two, stage ashore.

runway-dispatch-a.speaker: dispatch
runway-dispatch-a.zh: 指挥中心呼叫，消防三组、救护二组，前往跑道支援。
runway-dispatch-a.en: Fire three, medic two, respond to the runway.

runway-dispatch-b.speaker: dispatch
runway-dispatch-b.zh: 消防三组前往航空器位置，救护二组待命，注意跑道交通。
runway-dispatch-b.en: Fire three, approach the aircraft. Medic two, stand by.

land-response-a.speaker: responder
land-response-a.zh: 消防三组收到，正在前往。

land-response-b.speaker: responder
land-response-b.zh: 救护二组收到，车辆已出发。

water-response-a.speaker: responder
water-response-a.zh: 水警三号收到，救援艇已出发。

water-response-b.speaker: responder
water-response-b.zh: 救援二组收到，正在接近河岸。
water-response-b.en: Rescue two copies. Approaching the bank.

runway-response-a.speaker: responder
runway-response-a.zh: 消防三组收到，正在接近跑道。
runway-response-a.en: Fire three copies. Approaching the runway.

runway-response-b.speaker: responder
runway-response-b.zh: 救护二组收到，在指定位置待命。

land-confirm-history.spokenZh: 指挥中心，一五四九，已确认坠毁。

land-confirm-generic.zh: 指挥中心，云际320，已确认坠毁。
land-confirm-generic.spokenZh: 指挥中心，云际三二零，已确认坠毁。
land-confirm-generic.en: Dispatch, Skyline three two zero confirmed down.

water-confirm-history.zh: 指挥中心，1549，确认坠毁，位置在河面。
water-confirm-history.spokenZh: 指挥中心，一五四九，确认坠毁，位置在河面。
water-confirm-history.en: Dispatch, fifteen forty-nine confirmed down in the river.

water-confirm-generic.zh: 指挥中心，确认客机坠入水中，请求救援。
water-confirm-generic.en: Dispatch, airliner confirmed down in the water. Request rescue.

runway-confirm.zh: 位置已确认，救援车辆正在接近。
runway-confirm.en: Location confirmed. Emergency vehicles are approaching.

training-a.zh: 本次训练终止，进入飞行复盘。
training-a.en: Training terminated. Beginning the flight review.

training-b.zh: 本次任务结束，准备复盘。
training-b.en: This attempt is over. Prepare for the flight review.
